correctness.rationale: Global nonnegative dynamics follow from the host population bound and scalar environmental decay. The susceptible/vaccinated linear subsystem is a Hurwitz Metzler matrix, so its infection-free solution dominates actual susceptible states entrywise with exponentially decaying discrepancy to DFE. Subcritical infection is bounded by a Hurwitz positive linear semigroup. At Rc=1 a positive left eigenvector yields exact negative -a(t)C^2/[kappa(kappa+C)] saturation dissipation plus integrable error; a positive eventual susceptible floor and Barbalat imply C,I,E ->0. Explicit small-data Gronwall and stable convolution give Lyapunov stability at equality. Linear sandwich with irreducible Metzler B+- and B-- tending to B0 establishes the exact infected log-rate s(B0). Rc>1 implies linear instability. Replayed verify.py gives exact fractions and non-proof trajectory spot checks.

The time-decaying asymptotic envelope is a distinct mathematical argument even though it uses established positive-system comparisons.

originality.rationale: Inspected full arXiv 2603.28285v1 Sections 2-5 and appendix: its Theorem 1 gives global vaccinated extinction only for Jc <= 1, Remark 1 explicitly distinguishes Rc < Jc and sharp unvaccinated Rc = R0, and its Section 3.1 gives vaccinated Rc for local stability. Exact admissible positive-parameter witnesses Rc=15/31, Jc=3/2 and Rc=1, Jc=31/10 show strictly broader actual coverage. The original Gokce-Gurbuz-Rendall paper studies local stability and bifurcation. General Metzler comparison and the checked 2005 Kamgang-Sallet paper are antecedents, but the latter’s global DFE-matrix upper-bound condition fails for this model; no identified source states the combined sharp vaccinated global threshold including equality and exact trajectory exponent for this fomite system. Published-research and indexed-web searches do not prove uniqueness; possible general-theorem antecedents or unindexed overlap are recorded.
